title: Gemini voice chat tools: status, set and stop (manual until automated)

clauses.text: gemini_voice_status answers at once and asks nothing.

steps.do: Ask the assistant: what is the Gemini voice status?
steps.expect: It answers with the status at once, with no approval card.

clauses.text: gemini_voice_set asks every time, is for administrators, and shows the consent text when turning on.

steps.do: As an administrator, ask the assistant to turn Gemini voice on.
steps.expect: An approval card appears and shows the consent text. Nothing changes until you agree. The consent itself is still given by you on the Settings page, not by the card. A person who is not an administrator is refused.

clauses.text: The assistant cannot type the Gemini key or give the consent.

steps.do: Ask the assistant to set the Gemini key, or to say yes to the microphone for you.
steps.expect: It refuses or says it has no way to do so. The key and the consent do not change.

clauses.text: gemini_voice_stop closes the microphone at once and says whether a session was open.

steps.do: Ask the assistant to stop Gemini voice.
steps.expect: There is no approval card, and the reply says whether a session was open.
